entity_clark_desc: Clark is the S-tier stalker-listener haunting the yellow Backrooms-style corridors. He is patient, audio-sensitive, and tracks sprint footsteps, wall collisions, and voice chat with ruthless accuracy. He is not a chaser — he is a hunter.
entity_clark_behavior: Clark patrols the corridors in a dormancy phase, switching to active pursuit when a sound event crosses his detection threshold. Sprint, collision, and voice chat each amplify his awareness. His footsteps accelerate into audible breathing, then visible movement.
entity_clark_counter: Avoid sprinting, brief-click the flashlight, drop voice chat to push-to-talk, walk around corners instead of cutting, and keep a retreat path mapped. Squad coordination multiplies survival time by 3-4x over solo runs.
entity_clark_audioTell: Stage 1 — distant heartbeat (he is dormant). Stage 2 — slow breathing cadence (he is awake but far). Stage 3 — heavy footsteps (he is moving toward you). Stage 4 — close breathing (he is near; hide immediately).
entity_audioTracking_desc: Clark's audio tracking flag — once triggered, your position is locked into his awareness for a sustained window. Stacks across sprint, collision, and voice events.
entity_audioTracking_effect: Each loud event adds a tracking stack. At 1-2 stacks Clark investigates. At 3+ stacks Clark actively pursues. Detection decays slowly when you stay silent.
entity_audioTracking_trigger: Sprint steps, wall collisions, voice chat bursts, door interactions, flashlight held longer than 2s.
entity_audioTracking_behavior: Clark passively tracks sprint footsteps through audio cues, slowing down to analyze corridor acoustics and triangulate player positions within 30 meters. Each loud event layers onto his awareness until he locks onto your corridor segment.
entity_audioTracking_counter: Walk instead of sprint, avoid wall collisions, and keep voice chat on low volume during exploration phases. Standing still for several seconds decays his tracking stacks back toward zero.
entity_audioTracking_tell: Distinctive distorted breathing audible from 3-4 corridors away — direction can be triangulated with headphones and used to predict Clark's approach vector before he accelerates.
entity_flashlightSpotted_desc: Sustained flashlight beams broadcast your exact corridor to Clark. Brief clicks are silent; held beams are an invitation.
entity_flashlightSpotted_effect: Holding the flashlight for more than 2 seconds raises Clark's detection radius. He converges on the corridor segment you are illuminating.
entity_flashlightSpotted_trigger: Flashlight held continuously, or clicked rapidly while stationary (no movement decoy).
entity_flashlightSpotted_behavior: Clark reads sustained flashlight beams as a stationary target marker, locking his patrol path toward the illuminated corridor. He treats held light as a louder signal than sprint footsteps and converges faster.
entity_flashlightSpotted_counter: Brief-click the flashlight instead of holding it, only illuminate when turning corners, and extinguish the beam entirely during retreat phases to deny position data.
entity_flashlightSpotted_tell: A subtle audio shift — Clark's breathing pattern gains a faint static hiss as he picks up light signature, audible just before his pursuit speed escalates.
entity_lineOfSight_desc: Clark's secondary detection layer — if he can see you while also hearing you, his pursuit speed increases dramatically.
entity_lineOfSight_effect: Detected players under line of sight while sprinting suffer pursuit speed escalation. Break line of sight by ducking behind doors or rounding corners.
entity_lineOfSight_trigger: Visible to Clark in open-room and long-hall corridors while generating sound.
entity_lineOfSight_behavior: When Clark simultaneously sees and hears a target, his movement speed escalates into a sprint-tier pursuit. He cuts corners aggressively and skips his usual investigate pause, prioritizing direct interception.
entity_lineOfSight_counter: Break line of sight by rounding corners, ducking behind doors, or sliding into side corridors. Never sprint in open rooms where Clark can chain visual and audio detection.
entity_lineOfSight_tell: Clark's breathing accelerates sharply into a panting rhythm when he gains line of sight — distinct from his investigative cadence and a reliable signal to break visual immediately.
entity_breathingCadence_desc: An ambient tell that escalates as Clark closes distance. Learn the cadence to predict his dormancy and active states.
entity_breathingCadence_effect: Slower breathing = far away. Faster breathing = he is near. Heartbeat = he has fully awakened to your position.
entity_breathingCadence_trigger: Always active while Clark is awake; useful as a passive distance indicator.
entity_breathingCadence_behavior: Clark's breathing rhythm modulates continuously with distance — slow and distant when patrolling, accelerating as he closes in, and turning into a rapid heartbeat once he has fully locked your position.
entity_breathingCadence_counter: Use the cadence as a passive rangefinder: slow rhythm means retreat is safe, fast rhythm means prepare to hide. Pause movement entirely during heartbeat phases to let detection decay.
entity_breathingCadence_tell: A four-stage audio scale — dormant heartbeat, slow breathing cadence, heavy footsteps, close breathing — each stage compresses the available reaction window by roughly half.
entity_serverLocked_desc: Once the first door is opened, the server locks — no new players can join for the rest of the run. This is the defining Clark Huss rooms mechanic.
entity_serverLocked_effect: The door timer to lock is short (~30 seconds after first door). Plan the squad, batteries, and roles before committing. Late joiners cannot rescue you.
entity_serverLocked_trigger: Opening any door after the lobby grants the server-lock status.
entity_serverLocked_behavior: Once the first interior door opens, the lobby closes to new joiners and the run becomes a closed-environment commitment. The squad composition is fixed for the remainder of the session.
entity_serverLocked_counter: Coordinate the full squad before opening any door, distribute batteries and roles in the lobby, and avoid premature door triggers that lock the server before everyone is ready.
entity_serverLocked_tell: A low server-tone hum plays once the first door opens, accompanied by an on-screen 'Server Locked' badge — late joiners will see a rejected-connection message for the rest of the run.
strategy_controlledRetreat_desc: Walk backward, flashlight off, voice chat muted. Use brief clicks to peek corners. Retreat while monitoring Clark's breathing cadence.
strategy_silentRun_desc: Walk only — never sprint. Mute voice chat. Click the flashlight only when absolutely necessary. Slow but very safe.
strategy_audioFirst_desc: Use headphones, listen before walking. Pause at every junction and T-intersection. Let Clark's tells guide your path before committing.
strategy_panicSprint_desc: Panic sprint is a one-way ticket. It burns stamina, broadcasts loud footsteps, and rarely escapes an audio-tracked hunter. Use only as a last-second dash when no other option exists.
corridor_longHall_desc: Straight yellow corridor with multiple doors. Limited cover; Clark has a long line-of-sight sightline. Walk only.
corridor_longHall_danger: High — open sightlines amplify line-of-sight detection. Sprint here is suicide.

corridor_tJunction_danger: Medium — turning wrong way can lead to dead-end. Clark often waits at junctions.
corridor_deadEnd_desc: Corridor with no exit. Avoid unless you are intentionally scouting. Listen for breathing before entering.
corridor_deadEnd_danger: Low-medium — trapped if Clark is in the corridor beyond; escape requires running back.

corridor_junctionCluster_danger: Medium — disorientation risk; Clark can ambush from any branch.
